newsitem.title: UK: Telspec shares tumble on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Telspec shares tumble on profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Telspec Plc slumped on Tuesday after the telecoms equipment maker issued its second profit warning in four months and said it expected to make a 6 million stg pre-tax loss in the half year ended June 30.
The stock was down 165p at 237-1/2 by 1038 GMT, after earlier dropping as low as 225p -- the lowest since it was floated in July 1994.

In a statement, the company said the difficulties it first warned about in May had been "significantly worse" than it had first expected, though it still expected to return to profitable trading in the second half of the year.
In May Telspec shares tumbled after chairman Frank Hackett-Jones warned that the company's first-half results would be hit by a "number of temporary factors."
He said some high-margin sales had been deferred to the second half of the year and that trading in the Middle East and Asia/Pacific had fallen below earlier expectations.
He also said problems with raw material purchasing would squeeze profit margins and that the company had increased spending on product development.
Telspec shares hit a high of 10.50 stg last November.
